Hi, I just tried to load your preset but the SVM notifies me that

this preset file is either corrupted or not applicable to load as a preset. It claims that the JSON value could not be converted to System.Int32. Path:$Raids.RaidStartup.AIAmount | LineNumber: 344 | BytePositionInLine:28.
